verdict.rationale: Codex docs describe the full chain. You can start cloud tasks from GitLab issues and Linear issues (as well as GitHub pull requests and Slack). Tasks run in isolated, per-repo configured environments. You then review the summary and diff, request follow-ups, and open a pull request when the result is ready. Missing for 10: explicit support for starting from GitHub issues (only GitHub PRs are named), deeper documentation of the issue-to-PR workflow beyond one-line claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
